# Current function contracts — 0.16.2

October 24, 2026. Exact source comments, indexed at current locations. Earlier
FUNCTION-REFERENCE files remain intact as history. Coverage checks existence;
behavior tests and manual review check usefulness and accuracy.

### src/activity.js:7

@function activity.installReviewed — Installs conservative spatial broad-phase and distance scheduling services. Static props use 8-unit cells; moving actors/events remain live and sleeping never deletes authored/runtime state. Inputs: browser/global namespace root. Returns nothing; exposes the module API and initializes its private registration/cache state. Dependency or registration errors propagate. Does not create a second active simulation; exported operations own later session/UI work.

### src/activity.js:14

@function activity.reviewedcache_2 — Builds or retrieves the session spatial index. Inputs: live game with frontier entities and sourceWorld activity rules. Returns cached 8-metre buckets, live monster references and normalized scheduling rules. Mutates only private WeakMap on first access; source entity membership is assumed fixed for the session. Missing game/schema dependencies throw.

### src/activity.js:40

@function activity.reviewedquery_3 — Collects broad-phase candidates for an inclusive world XY rectangle in metres. Inputs: game, minX/minY/maxX/maxY and optional solid event filter. Returns a new array of coarse static bucket candidates plus exactly bounded live monsters/events; callers must perform narrow-phase checks. solid filters scene events only, not static props or monsters. Initializes cache if needed; invalid inputs are not validated here.

### src/activity.js:67

@function activity.reviewedactors_4 — Selects potential combat actors near the player without deleting sleeping state. Inputs: live game. Returns monsters and combat-enabled scene events within the maximum reduced/detection/leash distance plus hysteresis, retaining already aggressive actors regardless of distance. Distances use world XY metres. Initializes cache; no actor mutation; missing parameter service throws.

### src/activity.js:76

@function activity.reviewedcallback_5 — Selects scene events participating in combat. Inputs: live event e. Returns its combat record as a truthy inclusion value. No mutation; absent combat records exclude decoration and utility events.

### src/activity.js:82

@function activity.reviewedcallback_6 — Keeps nearby or already aggressive combat actors. Inputs: actor e and captured player/rules/game. Returns true when XY metre distance is within the conservative scheduling boundary or e.aggro is true. No state changes; configured detection/leash ranges prevent scheduling from suppressing acquisition.

### src/activity.js:95

@function activity.reviewedmotionDelta_7 — Schedules event motion using distance tiers and hysteresis. Inputs: game, event, current page and elapsed dt in seconds. Returns dt for always/autorun/parallel or active events, zero for dormant/not-yet-due events, otherwise accumulated reduced time capped at interval plus 0.1 seconds. Mutates private per-event tier/pending state; dormant time is discarded to avoid a catch-up jump. Requires validated page/rules and finite nonnegative dt; dependency errors propagate.

### src/actor-behavior.js:11

@function actor-behavior.defaults.2Reviewed — Creates a fresh authored behavior profile. Inputs: none. Returns sentinel defaults, speed 0.9 world units per second, ranges/radius in horizontal world units and a fresh empty waypoint list. Allocates independent data; does not install a controller or mutate a session.

### src/actor-behavior.js:23

@function actor-behavior.validate.3Reviewed — Validates and copies an authored behavior profile over defaults. Inputs: JSON-compatible profile. Returns normalized profile without changing input. Rejects unsupported modes, non-boolean approach, nonfinite/negative ranges above 128, speed above 12, chase below detection or stop above detection, and invalid waypoint arrays/coordinates. Patrol needs 1–64 points; points use horizontal world coordinates 1–511. JSON-copy errors propagate; actual cell bounds are checked separately.

### src/actor-behavior.js:68

@function actor-behavior.update.4Reviewed — Advances one actor horizontal behavior controller for the active event page. Inputs: entity, page/profile, elapsed seconds, optional target position, bounds/collision/trace services and session controller Map. Returns nothing; nonpositive elapsed time or absent profile is a no-op. Creates page-specific home state, pursues within detection/leash rules, returns home, patrols or deterministically wanders. Travel is capped to 0.25 seconds and split into at most 0.05-world-unit collision probes. Mutates position, facing unless direction-fixed, displacement fields vx/vy (not per-second velocity), behavior phase and walk animation. Through pages bypass canStand but retain bounds. Service errors propagate; this does not itself perform vertical stair/ground resolution.

### src/arsenal.js:4

@function arsenal.install — Inputs: initialized browser host. Returns nothing; configures existing weapon archetypes, adds one missing variant and connects distinct inventory ammo pools. No Quake assets/code are loaded. Presets become the baseline before project overrides are adopted.

### src/arsenal.js:31

@function arsenal.inventory — Inputs: live game. Returns its authoritative event inventory Map or null before session attachment. Does not create duplicate persistent ammo banks.

### src/arsenal.js:33

@function arsenal.pool — Inputs: equipped weapon. Returns distinct ammo item ID, defaulting to legacy pistol ammunition for unmapped archetypes. Melee returns null. No mutation.

### src/arsenal.js:35

@function arsenal.prepare — Inputs: live game before firing/pickup/menu rendering. Returns nothing; exposes pool quantities as loaded rounds for Quake-style guns. Legacy pistol keeps its magazine/reserve representation. Pool quantities are capped by the existing inventory/save bound, not fabricated when equipping.

### src/arsenal.js:37

@function arsenal.commitAmmo — Inputs: live game after shot/reload. Returns nothing; writes consumed pool quantity to the authoritative inventory, or mirrors pistol reserve for later weapon switches. Loaded pistol rounds remain in existing per-weapon magazine state.

### src/arsenal.js:38

@function arsenal.equip — Inputs: game and valid existing weapon profile ID. Returns equipped clone through original handler. Saves the old ammo representation, restores pistol reserve or the selected shared pool, and avoids free ammo from magazine switching. Authoring profile selection remains available; inventory UI offers only owned weapon pickups. Invalid IDs throw through original handler.

### src/arsenal.js:44

@function arsenal.reload — Inputs: live game and existing combat UI. Returns original reload result for magazine weapons, or nothing for direct-pool weapons. Explains pool behavior instead of performing a fake reload; preserves legacy sounds/timing for pistol. No ammo duplication.

### src/arsenal.js:46

@function arsenal.cost — Inputs: live game and weapon. Returns normal ammo cost or one-round fallback for double shotgun/super nail archetype when only one round remains. Does not consume ammunition.

### src/arsenal.js:48

@function arsenal.dischargeWeapon — Inputs: game after cost subtraction and immutable equipped weapon. Returns original weapon or a temporary reduced single-shell/single-nail configuration. Uses the fallback decision recorded before ammunition subtraction; it does not infer fallback from a potentially stale displayed round count. No modification of equipped presets or future shots.

### src/arsenal.js:50

@function arsenal.recordCost — Inputs: game and weapon. Returns cost while recording it for this immediate discharge's fallback. Persistent weapon balance and ammo are untouched.

### src/arsenal.js:52

@function arsenal.restore — Inputs: live game, saved profile ID and validated player scalars after inventory restoration. Returns equipped clone. Bypasses ordinary switching's outgoing-ammo write so imported pool counts cannot overwrite the pistol reserve. Restores saved magazine/current-round state without granting ammunition. Invalid profile errors propagate before saved scalars are assigned.

### src/asset-style.js:5

@function asset-style.installReviewed — Installs cached raster outline/phosphor styling for optional vector presentation. Variants are bounded to four per source and preparation belongs to image/style changes, not every rendered frame. Inputs: browser/global namespace root. Returns nothing; exposes the module API and initializes its private registration/cache state. Dependency or registration errors propagate. Does not create a second active simulation; exported operations own later session/UI work.

### src/asset-style.js:11

@function assetStyle.imageReviewed — Prepares an optional cached outline or monochrome canvas. Inputs: loaded image/canvas source, validated enabled/monochrome/hex-color settings and treatment string. Returns original source when disabled/original/absent; otherwise a same-size canvas, with outline interior alpha removed and optional RGB recoloring. Pixel coordinates are source pixels. Retains at most four variants per source in a WeakMap and evicts oldest insertion; does not alter source. Expects immutable source content, readable origin-clean pixels and available 2D context; tainted/unloaded images or canvas failures throw to caller.

### src/audio.js:6

@function audio.reviewed1 — Installs shared audio services and the footstep plugin registry. Inputs: existing MF engine namespace. Returns nothing; exposes registration and audio factory APIs. Requires MF/load order, does not unlock audio until a user gesture.

### src/audio.js:15

@function audio.reviewed2 — Registers a native audio extension. Inputs: plugin with stable id/defaults/hooks. Returns nothing; stores it by ID, replacing that ID if already registered. Caller supplies a valid plugin; does not start playback.

### src/audio.js:23

@function audio.reviewed3 — Creates isolated audio-controller ownership for a game session. Inputs: none. Returns controller with lazy shared Web Audio context, normalized master volume and footstep ownership. Installs the supplied sound-effect unlock callback; does not start audio or allocate a context until unlock.

### src/audio.js:31

@function audio.reviewed4 — Unlocks browser audio from an actual user gesture. Inputs: none. Returns a promise; lazily creates context/master/SFX gains, resumes suspended context and shares it with sound effects. Unlocks music too. Missing AudioContext is a silent no-op; context/resume errors reject. Reuses one context rather than creating one per sound.

### src/audio.js:48

@function audio.reviewed5 — Changes normalized master volume. Inputs: value coercible to a number, clamped 0..1 (invalid values become zero). Returns nothing; retains preference before context exists and forwards it to master gain, music, sound effects and combat synth. Does not start playback.

### src/encounter-example.js:3

@function encounter-example.installReviewed — Publishes editable encounter example data independently of bundled maps/shared gameplay defaults. Registration does not start a combat encounter or modify a playtest. Inputs: browser/global namespace root. Returns nothing; exposes the module API and initializes its private registration/cache state. Dependency or registration errors propagate. Does not create a second active simulation; exported operations own later session/UI work.

### src/encounter-example.js:8

@function encounter-example.world.2Reviewed — Inputs: base world to clone. Returns validated editable flat encounter world with spawn 5,7, no static objects, default water and fresh recruit/actor-7 companion/patrol events using normal event/behavior validation. Removes travel, interior and ground material while retaining other inherited base settings. Coordinates/ranges are horizontal world units and behavior speeds world units per second. Creates authored test definitions only; does not recruit, attack or mutate the supplied world. Clone/schema errors propagate.

### src/enemies.js:6

@function enemies.install — Inputs: browser namespace. Registers project enemy services and supplied sprite metadata without creating a game. Existing muzzle validation owns frame/calibration checks; errors propagate.

### src/enemies.js:11

### src/enemies.js:13

@function enemies.validate — Inputs: authored enemy extension. Returns detached normalized configuration; rejects unknown weapons, policy, blood identity or invalid units. Ammo -1 explicitly means unlimited; nonnegative ammunition is integer. Does not grant ammunition or mutate the event.

### src/enemies.js:19

@function enemies.preset — Inputs: supported weapon ID. Returns a detached editable spawn configuration from the actual arsenal; defaults to Chiban, finite ammo and permanent death. Invalid IDs fail explicitly. No catalog mutation.

### src/enemies.js:21

@function enemies.event — Inputs: stable ID, name, XY metres, configuration and optional sprite profile. Returns a genuine event with an ordinary editable active page and combat tag. Configuration stays in the event extension, leaving existing arbitrary event pages available. No world mutation.

### src/enemies.js:23

@function enemies.migrate — Inputs: authored world. Returns original if no legacy monsters, otherwise detached world with each monster converted to an event retaining stable ID, position, sprite, dimensions and original data as history. Rejects ID collisions rather than duplicating actors. Melee behavior is retained for unarmed legacy sentinels.

### src/enemies.js:24

@function enemies.unconfiguredEvent — Inputs: event. Returns whether combat event needs enemy metadata; no mutation.

@function enemies.hasLegacy — Inputs: object. Returns whether its legacy kind needs event migration; no mutation.

### src/enemies.js:29

### src/enemies.js:43

@function enemies.state — Inputs: live game and enemy actor. Returns its per-cell mutable state record, lazily initialized from current actor so legacy saves retain dead/HP state. Stores remaining ammo and delay independently of event-page rebuilds.

### src/enemies.js:45

@function enemies.beforeImpact — Inputs: live game and living event actor. Returns prior A-D self-switch values (null means absent), before combat can change death flags. No mutation; unrelated event switches are not owned by respawning.

### src/enemies.js:47

@function enemies.defeated — Inputs: game, lethally damaged actor and pre-impact switch snapshot. Records death timer and only flags changed by this death, so respawn can restore them without erasing preexisting quest/page state. Does not grant loot or replay death commands.

### src/enemies.js:49

@function enemies.fire — Inputs: live game, actor and proposed weapon. Returns allowed discharge or null for exhausted ammunition. Deducts a whole ammo cost once before pattern launch and supports final shell/nail fallback. Unlimited -1 is explicit. Existing non-enemy actors pass through untouched.

### src/enemies.js:51

@function enemies.reset — Inputs: live game, event-owned actor and saved state. Returns nothing; respawns at authored spawn, restores HP/ammo, restores only self-switches changed by the lethal impact and transient aggression. Retains arbitrary other event switches/commands. Renderer uses the existing billboard.

### src/enemies.js:51

### src/enemies.js:51

@function enemies.runtimeEvent — Inputs: event. Returns actor's event ID match; no mutation.

### src/enemies.js:53

@function enemies.update — Inputs: live game and active-cell elapsed seconds. Returns nothing; records lethal transitions once and advances delay only while the cell simulates. Paused/inactive cells do not advance timers; wall-clock time never silently respawns enemies.

### src/enemies.js:55

@function enemies.capture — Inputs: live game. Returns validated detached ammo/death/timer dictionary after observing current lethal transitions. No elapsed time passes during saving.

### src/enemies.js:57

### src/enemies.js:59

@function enemies.restore — Inputs: live game, validated/legacy cell snapshot and true only for actual cell travel. Returns nothing; restores ammo/timer state then applies reentry policy only to dead enemies. Loading the same cell never counts as reentry.

### src/enemy-tactics.js:3

### src/enemy-tactics.js:6

### src/enemy-tactics.js:6

### src/enemy-tactics.js:8

@function enemyTactics.tick — Inputs: game, actor, target, seconds and existing collision-aware move function. Returns whether tactics own locomotion this frame. Patrols before detection; pursuit stops at target/home limits and returns to spawn. Fresh hostile projectiles within four metres can initiate cover selection once per projectile; candidates must be static solid noncombat events and actually obstruct the shot line. Blocked travel abandons cover after two seconds rather than teleporting.

### src/enemy-tactics.js:15

@function enemyTactics.afterShot — Inputs: actor. Returns next allowed shot interval in seconds. Uses actual equipped weapon cadence, then adds author burst pause; magazine-empty pauses use the same explicit gap, never accelerate shots. Ammo accounting stays in FrontierEnemies.fire.
